summary: Comprehensive testing of ClinicQueue Expo app: backend (30 pytest cases all passing) and frontend UI/E2E flows. Full patient booking journey works: signup → home → search/filter → doctor profile → date/slot pick → payment choice → success → live queue with '#2' position and ETA. Doctor dashboard: mode toggles (active/break/emergency), KPI cards, Next Patient with Call Next work. Receptionist dashboard: 6 doctor chips, per-appointment action buttons (arrived/start/complete/skip) and Emergency Insert FAB all working. Queue positions correctly shift after receptionist completes an appointment. RBAC enforced (patient blocked from /api/doctor/dashboard with 403; unauth 401). Auth (login, signup, /me) works with JWT bearer. Only minor React Native Web deprecation warnings observed (non-blocking).

minor.issue: N+1 pattern: estimate_wait_for_doctor is awaited per doctor inside a loop. Fine for 6 doctors, but should be batched if catalog grows.

Uses get_current_user (any authenticated role) instead of role/ownership check. A patient can query queue for any appointment id if guessed. Low risk given UUID ids, but consider restricting to owner/doctor/receptionist.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow). React Native Web deprecation – not user-visible but should be modernized.

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated 'shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius' with boxShadow in RN web styles to silence console warnings.
(Optional) Add ownership check on GET /api/appointments/{id}/queue – restrict to owning patient or staff.
(Optional) Batch estimate_wait_for_doctor for GET /api/doctors to avoid N+1 mongo calls.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 570-line file mixing auth, doctor, appointment, and reception routes – consider splitting into modules if it keeps growing.
Seeded doctor emails are generated from name (lowercased, spaces/dots removed). Verified drrajeshkumar@clinic.com works; other emails follow same pattern.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded in all queries via projection {"_id": 0}.
All frontend interactive elements have testID attributes – excellent testability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (patient booking E2E, queue polling display, doctor dashboard, receptionist dashboard, emergency insert)

seed_data_creation: Created via signup during tests: TEST_patient_* accounts and TEST_p1_/TEST_p2_ patient accounts. TEST_Emergency + TEST Emergency UI emergency appointments were inserted for Dr. Rajesh Kumar. All prefixed with TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL as the request stated). Base URL: https://queue-live-demo.preview.emergentagent.com. pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_clinicqueue.py – 30 tests, ~4s. Doctor emails follow lowercased-name pattern; use drrajeshkumar@clinic.com/doctor123 for doctor testing. Every doctor password is doctor123. Patients must be created via signup (no seeded patient). Queue polls /api/appointments/{id}/queue every 5s and returns {my_position, eta_minutes, currently_serving, completed_count, total_in_queue}. Emergency inserts use token_number=0 so they sort to top.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found requiring RCA. MVP is fully functional end-to-end.
